text: RESULTS: ECG: Normal sinus rhythm, no ST-segment changes or arrhythmias detected. MRI Brain with contrast: Evidence of increased intracranial pressure with signs compatible with idiopathic intracranial hypertension. No masses or lesions observed.

text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension (Pseudotumor Cerebri) with secondary cardiac wall motion abnormalities likely due to a separate etiology or misinterpretation of stress-induced ischemia unrelated to the current headache.
